punchline: James Nestor taped his nose shut for ten days and his blood pressure went to 142.
thirty_sec: James Nestor and a breathing therapist had their noses plugged with silicone for ten days at Stanford, breathing only through the mouth. Nestor's snoring soared, he developed sleep apnea and his blood pressure hit 142. Ten days of nose breathing later, the apnea was gone and the pressure was back in a healthy range.
key_contrast: Mouth ten days, nose ten days
